headline: Formal charges filed against ex-minister Kamal Majumder, Nikhil and 17 others for crimes against humanity
summary: Prosecution submits charges to the International Crimes Tribunal for alleged killings and attacks during the July-August 2024 uprising in Mirpur.
details: Formal charges have been submitted to the International Crimes Tribunal against 19 individuals, including former state minister Kamal Ahmed Majumder and former Jubo League general secretary Mainul Hossain Khan Nikhil. The charges are related to alleged crimes against humanity committed in Mirpur during the July-August 2024 uprising.

The prosecution alleges that the accused were involved in killings and attacks targeting protesters and civilians in the Mirpur area. Prosecutor Gazi Monawar Hossain Tamim confirmed the submission of charges to journalists.

Kamal Majumder previously served as the state minister for industries and was an Awami League lawmaker for Dhaka-15. Mainul Hossain Khan Nikhil is a former MP for Dhaka-14 and ex-general secretary of the Jubo League.
The charges will now be presented to International Crimes Tribunal-1 for review. The tribunal will then decide whether to accept the charges and proceed with the case against the accused.

headline: Dooley makes four changes to starting XI for Singapore clash
summary: Coach Thomas Dooley drops Sohel Rana and Shakil Ahad Topu following a disappointing 3-0 loss to Malaysia in the FIFA AEAN Cup.
details: Bangladesh coach Thomas Dooley has made four changes to the starting lineup for Monday's match against Singapore in the FIFA AEAN Cup.
Midfielder Sohel Rana and defender Shakil Ahad Topu were dropped after a poor performance in the previous game against Malaysia, where Bangladesh lost 3-0.
Topu faced criticism for his role in the three goals conceded, while Sohel was lambasted by the coach for a lackluster effort.
The new additions to the starting XI include Zidane Yousuf in defense, Jamal in midfield, Shuki Itofusa, and Sheikh Morsalin.
Zidane, Shuki, and Morsalin all made positive impressions as second-half substitutes in the previous match, while regular captain Jamal returns to the lineup.
caption:
Four players out! Coach Thomas Dooley shakes up the lineup after a crushing 3-0 defeat.

Bangladesh coach Thomas Dooley has made four changes to the starting lineup for Monday's match against Singapore in the FIFA AEAN Cup.

Midfielder Sohel Rana and defender Shakil Ahad Topu were dropped after a poor performance in the previous game against Malaysia, where Bangladesh lost 3-0.

Topu faced criticism for his role in the three goals conceded, while Sohel was lambasted by the coach for a lackluster effort.

The new additions to the starting XI include Zidane Yousuf in defense, Jamal in midfield, Shuki Itofusa, and Sheikh Morsalin.

Zidane, Shuki, and Morsalin all made positive impressions as second-half substitutes in the previous match, while regular captain Jamal returns to the lineup.
